label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the _____, to go to Jesus.
verse: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
note: Peter steps out of the boat — the only disciple who tried walking on the water.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And if I go and prepare a _____ for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verse: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
note: Jesus's promise in the upper room: He's preparing a place, and He's coming back to bring you there.

label: Sunday School
prompt: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a _____ of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
verse: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
note: The trap for Daniel: no petition to any god or man but the king for thirty days — or into the lions' den.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a _____.
verse: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
note: Rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under threat: a trowel in one hand, a weapon in the other.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Rest in the LORD, and wait _____ for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verse: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
note: 'Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him' — Psalm 37 says 'fret not thyself' three times (verses 1, 7, and 8).
